# The fork watch's rule constants, pinned identically by BOTH engines' tests:
# Java ForkWatchTest.constantsMatchTheSharedTwinPins and Rust
# fork_watch::tests::constants_match_the_shared_twin_pins. Change a value here
# AND in both engines (ForkWatch.java, fork_watch.rs), or a suite fails.
min_peers=3
observation_ttl_seconds=86400
activation_grace_seconds=21600
max_horizon_seconds=34560000
lookback_seconds=34560000
max_tracked=512
enabled_networks=sepolia
